Content read-only may read source; Editor deploys existing Worker but cannot create/delete it.

findings.finding: MedASRのmedical dictationを「医療辞書」としている。「医療音声の書き起こし」へ訂正する。重要ポイントは既に書き起こしとしており、要約との整合も必要。

notes.comparison: Medical image modalities, MedQA/EHRQA, MedASR error reduction and $100k Kaggle challenge agree with primary sections. Free use refers to models, not a verified waiver of cloud infrastructure charges. Medical dictation is incorrectly translated as a medical dictionary in the summary.

Compared all four primary application sections. Forecast comparison is retrospective for original COVID work; flu/COVID public leaderboards and RSV internal analysis have different evidence scope. General cosmic-string solutions, GOES-East ten-minute CO2 estimates and simulation neural mechanisms support the Note. This is a comparison to the source, not independent replication.

Compared announced limited-access program, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber/CodeMender, verified deployment-ready patch generation in minutes, staged partner categories and operational standards. Note does not describe the model as generally available. Timing and performance remain the source author’s program claims.

Primary introduction directly supports every substantive summary/key-point claim: TypeScript/Node runtime rewritten to >800k production Rust lines, agent-written majority, 128 incrementally shipped PRs, primarily one developer over a few months and improved runtime performance. The limited Note does not reproduce detailed benchmark methods, nor does this check certify every number in the long original article.

Primary reporting-methodology and state-policy sections support the 98 requests in all 2025 versus 708 in H1 2026 comparison, duplicates/all received requests, rare actual takedowns, age assurance and content provenance. These are GitHub reporting statements at publication, not independent legal analysis or a claim about current law.

findings.finding: 原典のsub-second retrievalに対し重要ポイントがミリ秒単位と断定している。1秒未満へ修正する。

notes.comparison: Primary model list, dynamic video tools/modalities, benchmark maximums 88%/66%/7%, API availability and planned Ask YouTube rollout agree. The use-case section supports sub-second retrieval; it does not establish millisecond resolution. Replace the stronger precision claim.

findings.finding: 原典はTimesFM/TabFMのGemini for business統合を今後の予定としている。要約にも計画であることを明記する。
MedGemmaとAMIEをまとめてオープン化と記述しているが、原典はMedGemmaの公開とAMIEの臨床研究を分けている。AMIE公開を示唆しない表現にする。

notes.comparison: Compared all ten highlights. The article describes Gemini for business integration as upcoming, while the summary presents it as integration without a timing qualification. The medical key point groups MedGemma and AMIE as opening up; the source supports MedGemma open foundation and AMIE ongoing clinical research, not AMIE public release. The October 20 Synaptics launch update postdates the October 16 Note and is not a contemporaneous omission.

Primary cyclone article supports the extra-day average lead time (three-day versus previous two-day accuracy), nearly 20 TB and 5,000 historical storms, FGNs, a single 15-day forecast in under one minute on a TPU, 1,000-member ensembles, Melissa example, open code/weights and Weather Lab/Earth AI. These are the team's reported model evaluations, not official weather warnings.

Compared the two-day focus, non-CS entry, free learning and safe-failure sections. Participants' accounts support prototyping, Copilot/API assistance, trial-and-error learning and the safe third-place characterization. The Note positions the piece as an essay and does not present the author's opinion as a measured learning-effect trial.

Primary overview/results support four benchmarks, 3,513 public examples, Kaggle private-set stewardship and leaderboard, Gemini 3 Pro 68.8%, Search/Parametric improvement and all evaluated overall scores below 70%. The leading score is the article's reported comparison, not a claim about today's leaderboard.

Apple's primary abstract supports verifier-derived TL;DR feedback, conditioning on previous insights and insight backpropagation, Pass@128=0 dataset filtering, GRPO 0-1%, training 14-31% and insight-free evaluation 12-13%. SFTL;DR uses task/insight tuples and nearly recovers RLTL;DR and full-rollout SFT performance. These remain experiment-specific findings. The page only certifies October 2026, not an exact publication day.

Primary announcement supports native computer use in Gemini 3.5 Flash, replacement of the standalone model route, browser/mobile/desktop actions, long-horizon automation/testing and API availability. Adversarial training and the two enterprise safeguards agree. The safeguards are optional in the original; the Note states they are provided without claiming they are always enabled or eliminate prompt injection.

Primary model/features/results/regional sections support lightweight linear regression, hourly occupancy-change weights, California/Germany models and approximate 20% morning/40% evening error reduction versus Keep Current State. The source evaluation is 30-60 minutes on selected high-turnover stations with at least six ports; the Note associates the improvements with peak times and does not claim those gains for every station or horizon.

Primary capabilities/evaluation/partner/access sections support Earth AI tools, modular skills and upfront planning, four agent configurations, GeoKTools/GeoExpertQueries, early WHO/People in Need use and limited experimental Google Earth/A2A access. Partner time savings are reported cases. The source's autorater scores workflow adherence and treats outputs as expert-review drafts; the Note does not claim certified final-answer accuracy or general availability.

Primary architecture/performance/deployment sections agree with Gemma 4, Apache 2.0, 740M parameters, native text/code/image/audio/video embeddings, MRL 768 to 128 dimensions/up to six-fold storage reduction, 8K context, MTEB Code 68.76 to 78.68 and quantized Pixel 11 Pro active RAM around 191/567 MB. These RAM figures remain tied to the stated quantization/device conditions.

Apple primary abstract supports the shared open scheduler/adapters, hybrid real-time/idle-skipping clock, unmodified harness/memory, proxy token/log-probability recording, seven benchmarks, ten models/configurations, native versus added memory conclusion and Qwen3.5-4B post-training improvements. Improvements are restricted to the reported experiments; the page certifies September 2026 without an exact day.

Primary theory/production/public-trace sections support time-and-size linear memory cost, separation of TTL and capacity eviction, lightweight decision-tree prediction in Spanner, fallback LRU, public GDSF baselines and production 15.5% memory reduction/5.5% more misses/about 5% lower TCO. The article explicitly describes Spanner production-server integration; these percentages are the reported production comparison, not a universal cache guarantee.

findings.finding: AligNetの判断データ数と画像数を混同し、100万枚の画像を数百万枚と記述している。原典は100万枚の画像から数百万の判断を生成すると説明する。

notes.comparison: Primary three-step method supports THINGS-trained regularized adapter on frozen SigLIP-SO400M, teacher-generated judgments, student fine-tuning, hierarchical alignment, cognitive tasks and better few-shot/distribution-shift results. The source distinguishes millions of odd-one-out decisions from one million distinct images. The summary incorrectly makes the image count several million. Neither alignment nor reliability is established as perfect.

Primary introduction and Vlad interview support all three named Java Champions, Hypersistence Optimizer event-history app implemented in two days versus an estimated weeks, IntelliJ plugin use for review/debugging, skills derived from past articles and retained human review/accountability. The Note treats these as practitioner examples, not a controlled or general productivity multiplier.

Primary launch supports the model's speed/rhythm/tone improvements, ComplexFuncBench Audio and Audio MultiChallenge results, developer preview Live API, enterprise customer-experience access, consumer Live experiences and Search Live expansion to over 200 countries/territories. SynthID on all generated audio agrees. It supports AI-content detection; it does not guarantee misinformation prevention.

Primary overview/system/PDAC/Fellows sections support the multimodal biology world model plus researcher/tool/literature harness, iterative wet-lab loop, Broad collaboration prioritizing thousands of compounds and validating selected state-shift candidates. The Note preserves research-only/non-clinical status and planned restricted Fellows access; it does not claim an approved treatment or general availability.

Primary architecture/performance sections support two chiplets with six 800 Gbps NICs each, 1.2 TB/s without PCIe, 16 message engines, under 0.5% compute degradation in concurrent tests and compiled HCCL autonomous collectives. The reported 3.9x communication comparison uses a 150-billion-parameter model across 40 accelerators, not an overall training-speed guarantee.

findings.finding: 資料の位置づけが小型モデルの容量制約を短い文脈の問題としている。原典のsmall models/limited model capacityに合わせる。

notes.comparison: Apple primary abstract supports selection from reusable natural-language reasoning candidates, likelihood selection without extra task head, teacher-forced concurrent scoring/shared KV, seven benchmarks, 2B/4B models, over 90% per-turn reasoning and 28-54% per-question inference latency reduction. The context section changes the motivation from limited small-model capacity to short context, which the source does not establish.

US health/environment, Nigeria downscaling and DRC nowcasting comparisons support the stated experimental scope. Weeks-to-minutes is the authors' reported workflow result; the Note identifies PPE as experimental research.

Primary pipeline/validation/impact sections agree with over 150 countries, 2000-present, 2.6M events, 80-language extraction/translation, Gemini classification/time/location reasoning, 82% practical accuracy, 85-100% GDACS severe-event coverage and Flood Hub urban forecasts up to 24h. Practical accuracy is distinct from the source's stricter 60% location-and-time accuracy; the Note does not equate 82% with exact extraction of every field.

Primary method/experiments support aggregated anonymized mobility plus text, self-supervised place embeddings, multiscale propagation for sparse POIs, cosine alignment and LA/Houston evaluation on unseen places. The Note describes place-level predictions and the tested cities; it does not claim individual-user inference or general global validation.

findings.finding: human-on-the-loopへの全面移行を完了したように述べているが、原典は目標であり一部工程では人が各反復に関与すると明記する。段階的な自律化として訂正する。

notes.comparison: Primary Forum article supports verified outcomes, tools reading screen hierarchy, separate prototype build, autonomous stress-testing example, roughly halved memory/page faults and eight-week core feature parity. It explicitly says human-on-the-loop is a target with some stages still human-in-the-loop. Summary/key point instead present the transition as achieved and need that limitation.

Primary service/harness/context/review sections support invitation-only Managed Defense early access, authorized-code investigation with GPT-5.6 Cyber, production Web Assets/WAF/Workers evidence, prioritization, validated patch/rule proposals and customer control. findings.finding: 重要ポイントが10/19を鍵の侵害発生日としている。原典が示すのはCloudflareの把握時刻（10/19約17:00 UTC）であり、侵害そのものの発生日とは区別する。

notes.comparison: Primary incident/response/customer/developer sections support eight weak intermediate-certificate keys, forgery risk, WARP/cloudflared updates, CDN/Zero Trust mitigations, trust-store/dependency/image checks and retained verification. October 19 is when Cloudflare learned of the compromise (about 17:00 UTC), not the established time the keys were first compromised. The summary says awareness correctly, but the first key point conflates those dates.

Primary migration/coordination/read-scale sections support 99.99999% dual-location repositories, August 2025 first Central US copy, two of five Azure replicas for most repositories, about half traffic and 25ms cross-region constraint. Per-reference quorum and storage/compute decoupling remain staged work; the Note presents them as future direction rather than completed universal stateless operation.

Primary announcement supports the five named consultancies, a possible $15.7T contribution by 2030, the cited 25% production-at-scale adoption figure, three pillars and sector focus. These are the announcement's forecast/cited adoption statements, not independently established global outcomes or a promise of realized economic gains.

The Note labels the piece an October 2026 essay and presents its interface vision as the author's argument rather than universal adoption or a measured productivity trial.

The key point's wording can make forty seconds sound like additional extension length and should state the cumulative cap.

Primary architecture/flow/storage/transparency sections support CVM/TEE isolation from host and operator, blind-signed anonymous credentials, third-party OHTTP routing, hardware attestation, encrypted user-key state and ledger/audit/bounty mechanisms. These are Meta's stated design/threat-boundary guarantees, not our independent security certification. The Note does not claim all binaries are openly downloadable; the source limits binary access to its research program under agreement.

Other surface variables remain 10 km and atmospheric variables 25 km.
